locator: {lang}:{path}:{kind}:{qualified_name}  (qualified_name from FileAnalysis::scope_path + decl name; preserves impl/receiver context)

facets.name_digest: sha256 over the declaration name — always present
facets.header_digest: sha256 over the header/signature text (decl.range minus body) — signature/interface facet
facets.body_digest: sha256 over body_range bytes — implementation facet; absent when no body

facets_prove: only equality of the selected source facets
missing_historical_bytes: facets = None (UNKNOWN) — never reconstructed from current source (§13); rebinding falls back to locator-only conservative states
captured_at: symbol_exposure resolve (bytes via SourceStore for non-indexed versions, or the live indexed file via provider.with_source_root)
